answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 56451 Country: India Title: nikah Question: Please clarify whether two real unmarried sisters can be given in nikah to one person? Answer ID: 56451 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 45/45/M=01/1436) It is unlawful and haram to combine two real sisters in wedlock. It has been mentioned in surah Nisa. If you do not combine them i.e. first you married one sister and later you gave her talaq due to some reason and then after her iddah was over you married her real sister then it is lawful. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
